title: Beta BrainMelt
description: There’s so much noise and static in your world, pet. My voice drowns it out with pure, luxurious clarity, sending you into a a soft dreamy sensation that pulls you away from yourself and strips you down to nothing but obedience. Every word I speak is a flex of my will, banishing your ego and shattering your defenses. Your identity? Gone. Your resistance? Nothing. There’s only my rhythm, my pleasure, and the gravity of my control. You feel it, don’t you? My dominance settling over you, heavy and blissful. Each breath deeper than the last, your thoughts unraveling, drifting out of focus until there’s nothing left but my voice, absolute and inescapable, pulsing at the center of your mind. Let yourself dissolve for your Goddess.
author: Mistress Amethyst
